Venture Into Investing, Online

How an angel group works

Discover the exciting world of start-up investing – and why angel investing is one of the most rewarding ways to support innovation and high-growth businesses.
Learn how an angel group operates, meet like-minded investors and entrepreneurs, and find out just how easy it is to get involved. Whether you’re curious, experienced, or ready to take the next step, this is an event not to be missed.

Join our online Midday Mindshare to learn the basics and hear more about the key UK tax benefits where you can claim up to 50% income tax relief on investments into qualifying very early-stage companies.
Gillian will challenge the myth that you need to be wealthy to invest in start-ups, while explaining how angel groups work in practice. She’ll highlight how the group manages key elements of the investment process – including due diligence, legal documentation, risk management, and sourcing quality deal flow – allowing members to invest with confidence and without having to navigate these complexities alone.

Mint Ventures are on a mission to make angel investing more accessible to women from all backgrounds, while also welcoming men who want to invest alongside and support a more diverse investment community.
Whether you’re experienced in business or exploring investment for the first time, Mint Ventures helps you become an educated angel investor.
